_meta.confidence: Category-level names/definitions (PC01-05, PA01-13): verbatim from plain-text appendixC.rst, high confidence. Sub-activity id/name: vision-transcribed from Figure 19, reasonably legible. Sub-activity description text: the highest transcription-risk part of this file -- treat as best-effort, spot-check against the bundled figure before citing a specific description in a paper. PA02.06.02's id is inferred, not printed in the source figure (see raw data's id_inferred flag). Re-checked against a second independent read of Figure 19 (post-build review): fixed one wording error (PA01.04), and PA03.02/PA03.03/PA03.04 are flagged confidence=low in the raw data -- two independent transcription passes parsed that specific densely-wrapped table region differently and neither could be confirmed as definitively correct.

contextual_domains.name: Environment

contextual_domains.name: Data Type

sub_activities.name: Imprecise

sub_activities.name: Absent

sub_activities.name: Misleading / false

sub_activities.name: Imprecise
sub_activities.description: Key data actions are not clearly stated

sub_activities.name: Insufficient

sub_activities.name: Absent

sub_activities.name: Misleading

sub_activities.name: Application or Registration

sub_activities.description: Collecting information or generating information about a data subject through repeated actions

sub_activities.name: Sniffing & affording
sub_activities.description: Collecting information from a device's broadcast signals or divulging application data

sub_activities.name: Soliciting
sub_activities.description: Collecting information from a broadcast signal by using false pretenses to manipulate the data subject into divulging

sub_activities.name: Pretexting
sub_activities.description: Collecting information by using false pretenses to manipulate the data subject into divulging some unrelated purpose

sub_activities.name: External appropriation
sub_activities.description: Using personal information legitimately collected by another entity for some unrelated purpose

sub_activities.name: Interception
sub_activities.description: Collecting information flows in transit between their source and destination

sub_activities.name: Soliciting & affording soliciting
sub_activities.description: The data subject is prompted to provide information and/or make available/facilitate functionality

sub_activities.name: 2nd Party Solicits 1st Party
sub_activities.description: Information custodian entices individuals to disclose more personal information than they otherwise might and/or enables others to do the same

sub_activities.name: 3rd Party Solicits 2nd Party
sub_activities.description: A third-party entices an information custodian to disclose more of a data subject's personal information than they otherwise might and/or enables others to do the same, including purchasing information

sub_activities.name: 3rd Party Solicits 1st Party
sub_activities.description: A third-party entices the data subject to disclose additional personal information and/or enables others to do the same

sub_activities.name: Recording
sub_activities.description: Capturing a physical or digital artifact representing an aspect or likeness of the data subject

sub_activities.name: Transaction
sub_activities.description: Logging information pertaining to monetary transactions

sub_activities.name: Biological sample
sub_activities.description: Collecting biological materials or specimens (e.g., blood, urine, tissue, cells, or saliva) from the data subject

sub_activities.name: Extraction
sub_activities.description: Capturing data directly from a device

sub_activities.name: Legal proceeding
sub_activities.description: Data submitted by the data subject or their representative as part of a legal proceeding

sub_activities.name: Insufficient access controls
sub_activities.description: Operational constraints for managing access to personal information are insufficient or flawed

sub_activities.name: Insufficient encryption
sub_activities.description: Adequate encryption is not properly implemented

sub_activities.name: Undermining / interfering with authentication
sub_activities.description: Intervening in authentication processes such that chains of trust are disrupted or other operational assumptions are invalidated

sub_activities.name: Detection failure
sub_activities.description: Relevant system events are not captured and/or identified

sub_activities.name: Misconfigured permissions
sub_activities.description: System, application, or service data handling permissions allow unauthorized handling

sub_activities.name: Implicit identification
sub_activities.description: Inferring the data subject's identity from a collection of data points

sub_activities.name: Re-identification
sub_activities.description: Re-associating data with the data subject that had been treated to remove those associations

sub_activities.name: Identifier assignment
sub_activities.description: Assigning an identifier

sub_activities.name: Direct identifier
sub_activities.description: Assigning a direct identifier (e.g., name, SSN)

sub_activities.name: Pseudo-identifier
sub_activities.description: Assigning a pseudo-identifier (e.g., a randomly generated ID)

sub_activities.name: Fingerprinting
sub_activities.description: Constructing a device, system, or application pseudo-identifier based on a unique set of properties

sub_activities.name: Compulsory self-identification
sub_activities.description: Requiring the data subject to provide a direct identifier, does not apply to pseudonyms

sub_activities.name: Age not vetted
sub_activities.description: Age of the user is not checked before performing data actions

sub_activities.name: Unvetted source
sub_activities.description: Source of the data is not considered when performing data actions

sub_activities.name: Unvetted data quality
sub_activities.description: Quality of the data is not considered when performing data actions

sub_activities.name: Bias of data not evaluated
sub_activities.description: Data action is not evaluated for biases

sub_activities.name: Unvetted data accuracy
sub_activities.description: Accuracy of the data is not considered when performing data actions

sub_activities.name: Unvetted recipients
sub_activities.description: The legitimacy and/or trustworthiness of downstream data recipients has not been assessed

sub_activities.name: Unvetted downstream practices
sub_activities.description: The legitimacy and/or trustworthiness of downstream data processes has not been assessed

sub_activities.name: Insufficient communication of downstream responsibilities
sub_activities.description: The legitimacy and/or trustworthiness of downstream data stewardship responsibilities has not been assured

sub_activities.name: Data insufficiently de-identified
sub_activities.description: Insufficient data processing to prevent identification of the data subject

sub_activities.name: Data out of scope
sub_activities.description: Action leverages data types outside of limits established by any relevant source

sub_activities.name: Data collection out of scope
sub_activities.description: Collection exceeds limits bounding that action established by any relevant source

sub_activities.name: Data collection out of scope
sub_activities.description: Collection exceeds limits bounding that action established by any relevant source

sub_activities.name: Data processing out of scope
sub_activities.description: Processing exceeds limits bounding that action established by any relevant source

sub_activities.name: Data sharing out of scope
sub_activities.description: Sharing exceeds limits bounding that action established by any relevant source

sub_activities.name: Insufficient agreed usage restrictions
sub_activities.description: Data use agreement for data processor, third-parties, and downstream data recipients is insufficient or absent

sub_activities.name: No individual access to information
sub_activities.description: The data subject or their proxy cannot obtain or view their collected personal data

sub_activities.name: No individual management of information content
sub_activities.description: The data subject or their proxy cannot transform (e.g., move, copy, edit) their collected personal data

sub_activities.name: No individual deletion of information
sub_activities.description: The data subject or their proxy cannot delete their collected personal data

sub_activities.name: No individual control of information disclosure
sub_activities.description: The data subject or their proxy cannot control how or with whom their information is shared

sub_activities.name: No individual control of information use
sub_activities.description: The data subject or their proxy cannot control how their information is used

sub_activities.name: Privacy configurations compromised by outside forces
sub_activities.description: The data subject's privacy settings are compromised by dependencies on the settings of others

sub_activities.name: Confounded controls
sub_activities.description: User controls are opaque or ineffective, including frustrating the data subject's attempts to utilize controls

sub_activities.name: Bypass of user controls
sub_activities.description: Defeating or ignoring a privacy control within or outside a functional context

sub_activities.name: Pre-emption of privacy settings
sub_activities.description: Preventing the data subject from influencing an action or event by initiating or executing it before they have an opportunity to affect it

sub_activities.name: Profiling
sub_activities.description: Assembling and organizing data points regarding specific data subjects

sub_activities.name: Single source profiling
sub_activities.description: Assembling and organizing data points about specific data subjects from a single source

sub_activities.name: Multi-source profiling
sub_activities.description: Assembling and organizing data points about specific data subjects with data points from multiple sources

sub_activities.name: Clustering
sub_activities.description: Assembling and organizing data points regarding groups of people

sub_activities.name: Single source clustering
sub_activities.description: Assembling and organizing data points regarding groups of people from a single source

sub_activities.name: Multi-source clustering
sub_activities.description: Assembling and organizing data points regarding groups of people from multiple sources

sub_activities.name: Deriving new information
sub_activities.description: Determining or extracting novel information by analyzing personal data

sub_activities.name: Deriving information about individuals
sub_activities.description: Determining or extracting novel information about the data subject by analyzing personal data

sub_activities.name: Deriving aggregate information
sub_activities.description: Determining or extracting novel aggregate information by analyzing personal data

sub_activities.name: Deriving sensitive information
sub_activities.description: Determining or extracting novel sensitive information by analyzing personal data

sub_activities.name: Deriving derogatory information
sub_activities.description: Determining or extracting novel derogatory information by analyzing personal data

sub_activities.name: Behavioral analysis
sub_activities.description: Leveraging information to determine or infer the behavior of an individual or group of individuals

sub_activities.name: Introducing bias
sub_activities.description: Data action is adversely influenced by bias

sub_activities.name: Trawling datasets for information
sub_activities.description: Reviewing aggregated collections or streams of information for items of interest

sub_activities.name: Internal appropriation
sub_activities.description: Using personal information legitimately collected for some unrelated purpose

sub_activities.name: Affording revelations
sub_activities.description: Making available information that should be protected at the conclusion of its lifecycle

sub_activities.name: Exposure
sub_activities.description: Information that should be protected is made generally discoverable and accessible, including a subset of a larger body of information (e.g., access controls, redaction, database views)

sub_activities.name: Doxing
sub_activities.description: Disseminating information for purposes of harassment, in terms of the release itself and/or its exploitation by others without necessary or proper interpretation

sub_activities.name: Misrepresentation
sub_activities.description: Downstream data recipients are in violation of usage agreements

sub_activities.name: Implication
sub_activities.description: Establishing a particularized derogatory suspicion or accusation regarding the data subject

sub_activities.name: Targeting
sub_activities.description: Distinguishing specific data subjects for treatment

sub_activities.name: Tailored content
sub_activities.description: Customizing the information presented to the data subject

sub_activities.name: Manipulation
sub_activities.description: Leveraging information to exploit, control, or inappropriately deliver a benefit to the data subject

sub_activities.name: Extortion
sub_activities.description: Coercing the data subject to accrue benefits or to avert loss through use, disclosure, or destruction of information

sub_activities.name: Intrusion
sub_activities.description: Invasions or incursions into the data subject's affairs

sub_activities.name: Revenue
sub_activities.description: Information is used to generate revenue, including a commercial sale

sub_activities.name: Reprisal
sub_activities.description: Leveraging information to retaliate against the data subject

sub_activities.name: Data not destroyed after use
sub_activities.description: Information has not been disposed at the conclusion of its lifecycle

sub_activities.name: Data improperly destroyed
sub_activities.description: Information remains at least partially recoverable despite attempts to destroy it

sub_activities.name: Deviating from usage restrictions
sub_activities.description: Downstream data recipients are in violation of usage agreements

sub_activities.name: Deviating from stated policy or user agreements
sub_activities.description: Data action deviates from stated policies or user agreements

sub_activities.name: Deviating from claimed certification conformance
sub_activities.description: An entity does not actually hold a claimed certification or is not actually adhering to a claimed standard

sub_activities.name: Deviating from regulatory requirements
sub_activities.description: An entity is violating a specific regulation that applies to it
